main_text.head: FLORENTIUS SCHUYL PRO VETERI MEDICINA.
main_text.p: Confutationem impudentissimi Libelli justa extorsit indignatio. Quis enim æquo animo ferat, hominem nomine duntaxat & professione Medicum, non alia de causa, quàm quia Sylvius Practicam suam candidè & liberaliter Orbi Literario impartivit, expressis verbis editoque libello effutire, sibi duntaxat sordi esse Sylvium, Veteranum Practicum, perstringere1. Pag. 4.? & quidem tàm contumeliosè, ut ipsum non pudeat, Virum Clarissimum, & de re Medica optimè meritum vocitare insignem erronem2. Pag. 16., nec devium3. Pag. 65. modò, sed &

page.notes: Large decorated initial C at the start of the first paragraph, read as "Confutationem" with the initial C joined. Some words at the left edge are cut off by the scan (e.g. "axat", "alia", "in", " editoque"); the original reads "duntaxat", "aliâ", "suam", "editoque" and these are restored only where clear. Footnote markers 1, 2, 3 are printed in the text and repeated below; the reference "Pag." notes are printed in the footer line.
